# Debbie Flynn & Associates — Lawyers Wagga Wagga

> Trusted legal practitioners based in Wagga Wagga, New South Wales, serving clients across the Riverina region for over 20 years.

## Core Legal Services
- **Family Law**: Compassionate guidance and advice on divorce, property settlement, parenting arrangements, and separation agreements.
- **Conveyancing & Real Estate**: Efficient property transactions, buying and selling homes, title transfers, and contract advice.
- **Children's Court & FACS**: Representation for family and community services (FACS / DCJ) matters, child protection, and legal support.
- **Legal Aid NSW Approved**: Experienced representation for eligible Legal Aid clients in Wagga Wagga and surrounding districts.
- **Criminal Law & Police Matters**: Local Court representation, traffic offences, police interviews, and defense representation.
- **Wills, Estates & Probate**: Drafting wills, power of attorney, enduring guardianship, and estate administration.
- **Property Law & Contracts**: Commercial and residential legal advice, contract review, and dispute resolution.
